newsitem.title: USA: Texaco forms worldwide lube, additives unit.
newsitem.headline: Texaco forms worldwide lube, additives unit.

text.p: Texaco Inc said Thursday it has formed a Worldwide Lubricants, Coolants and Fuels Additives business unit.
It said Thomas S. Neslage has been appointed general manager of the new unit, which will be based in Houston.

In 1994 he was appointed managing director and chief executive officer of the Hydro-Texaco joint venture, which markets fuels and lubricants under the Hydro-Texaco brand throughout Scandinavia and the Baltic Region.

Most recently, he has been on special assignment relating to Texaco's discussions with the Royal Dutch/Shell Group's Shell Oil Co and Saudi Aramco concerning the possible formation of a U.S. downstream business venture.
